## Essay use

Primary source for the paired-comparison model underlying later preference modelling. The essay's “hidden zero” argument concerns invariance under additive shifts of latent scores and therefore needs a modern technical source stating identifiability/gauge conditions explicitly alongside the original paper.

**Claim boundary:** Bradley and Terry warrant the model and its identifiability properties. The philosophical meaning assigned to an unidentifiable origin is the essay's argument from those properties.
